title: test: use precise timing for run timeout
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

#### What does this PR do?

Fedora 44 CI showed that Bash `$SECONDS` can round the measured runtime down to one second, causing the run timeout test to fail even when the timeout is working. This updates the test to measure elapsed time in milliseconds and assert that the command takes more than one second and no more than six seconds.
